claims.claim_text: Official records support a high-confidence match between indexed 1st Lt Michael Rajacich and the U.S. lieutenant and Operation Halyard team member of that name.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Attestation from U.S. Lieutenant MICHAEL RAJACICH, Military Intelligence
claims.evidence_paraphrase: A 1946 U.S. Army document identifies Lieutenant Michael Rajacich in military-intelligence context; a Department of Defense account identifies him on the OSS Operation Halyard team.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High-confidence match based on an uncommon exact name, compatible lieutenant rank in the contemporary official record, and independently corroborated OSS service.
claims.temporal_assessment: Both sources document wartime or postwar service context. Neither establishes a civilian employer before OSS.
claims.match_notes: The official sources resolve identity and OSS context only; they do not support the discovery-only claim that Rajacich worked for the War Department before OSS.
